title: Factorization of a product average
statement: Let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be finite types, and let $f:A\to\mathbb{R}$, $g:B\to\mathbb{R}$, and $h:C\to\mathbb{R}$. The uniform average of $f(a)g(b)h(c)$ over $(a,b,c)\in A\times B\times C$ equals $(\mathbb{E}_a f(a))(\mathbb{E}_b g(b))(\mathbb{E}_c h(c))$.
